domain_description: Comprehensive mechanical engineering analysis covering stress analysis, vibration, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, materials science, machine design, HVAC, piping, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, pumps, compressors, bearings, gears, welding, NDT, corrosion, fatigue, FEA, and reliability engineering per ASME, ASTM, AWS, and API standards.
authority_sources: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (BPVC) Section VIII

engines.name: Stress Analysis Engine
engines.function: Perform structural stress analysis including static, dynamic, and thermal stress calculations for mechanical components using analytical methods and FEA correlation per ASME codes.
doctrine_topics: uniaxial and multiaxial stress analysis
von Mises and Tresca yield criteria
stress concentration factors and notch sensitivity
thermal stress analysis and thermal cycling
contact stress (Hertzian) calculations
residual stress evaluation and measurement
ASME BPVC allowable stress criteria
combined loading analysis (bending, torsion, axial)
buckling analysis for columns and shells
creep and stress rupture at elevated temperatures

golden_queries.question: Analyze a pressure vessel nozzle-to-shell junction under combined internal pressure of 500 psi and external nozzle loads (axial force, bending moment, torsion) per ASME BPVC Section VIII Division 2

engines.name: Vibration Analysis Engine
engines.function: Analyze mechanical vibration in rotating and reciprocating equipment including natural frequency calculation, resonance avoidance, balancing, and vibration-based condition monitoring.
doctrine_topics: natural frequency and mode shape calculation
forced vibration response and resonance identification
rotor dynamics and critical speed analysis
vibration measurement and spectrum analysis
balancing procedures (single-plane and multi-plane)
torsional vibration analysis for drivetrain systems
vibration isolation and damping design
modal analysis and experimental modal testing
vibration severity standards (ISO 10816, ISO 20816)
vibration-based predictive maintenance diagnostics

golden_queries.question: A centrifugal compressor running at 8,400 RPM shows a dominant 1X vibration of 4.2 mils pp at the outboard bearing with a subsynchronous component at 0.42X. Diagnose the vibration sources and recommend corrective actions per ISO 20816

golden_queries.question: Analyze a combined cycle gas turbine plant with a GE 7HA.03 gas turbine and triple-pressure HRSG, calculating overall thermal efficiency, exergy destruction in each component, and identifying optimization opportunities

engines.name: Fluid Mechanics Engine
